repairs.description: Replaced the mostly domain-list summary with a table-family navigation map and explicit finalized, draft-snapshot, breakdown-snapshot, effective-time, and version-selection guidance.
Elevated the global warning that all columns may appear nullable because of the export methodology and distinguished it from field-level business optionality.
Added the narrow contracts_commits scope and the need to follow table-specific time/version selection rules rather than assuming one current row per object ID.
Changed the Luna claim that payment data is in Private Beta to the source's narrower statement: the note in the Payments section says Metronome invoicing is currently in Private Beta.
Created the planned metronome-reporting-and-analytics concept for cross-source warehouse grain, snapshot, nullability, and query guidance.

review.notes: Read all 1,600 raw lines and the complete Luna output, draft, and receipt. Luna correctly covered the major table families, deduplicated-event semantics, invoice snapshot behavior, contract breadth, payments, alerts, and the nullable-column warning. Sol improved query usefulness through grain and record-selection guidance, corrected the Private Beta scope, and kept the source explicitly non-exhaustive with a raw deep-dive link.
